Card Q&A.a: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [Terriermon] name.
q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly?
(*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [Terriermon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Terriermon].")

a: Players should reference "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Terriermon]."
Cards with the "this card/Digimon is also treated as [Terriermon]" text are treated as if they have the other text.
Card Q&A.q: This card has two different texts with the same card number: "This card/Digimon is also treated as [Terriermon]" and "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Terriermon]." Which should I reference?

Effect: [Your Turn] When an effect suspends this Digimon, 1 of your Digimon gets +4000 DP for the turn.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] When ＜Alliance＞ suspends one of your Digimon, this Digimon may digivolve into a 2-color green Digimon card in your hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 2.
